name: @nlbs/css
description: High-performance CSS foundation for Nanoo Labs

scripts.build: lightningcss --minify --bundle --targets 'last 2 versions' src/tokens.css -o dist/tokens.min.css && lightningcss --minify --bundle --targets 'last 2 versions' src/main.css -o dist/nanoo.min.css
scripts.dev: chokidar 'src/**/*.css' -c 'lightningcss --bundle src/tokens.css -o dist/tokens.css && lightningcss --bundle src/main.css -o dist/nanoo.css'

author: Adnan Slamet Wibowo <adnan@nanoolabs.dev>
